title: Error Certificates for KV-Cache Eviction via Randomized Design
abstract: arXiv:2607.21475v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deterministic KV-cache eviction keeps the top-$k$ tokens under an importance score and deletes the rest, and after the deletion the serving system cannot know what the eviction cost it on the current query. We replace the deterministic tail with Poisson sampling at known inclusion probabilities, which makes the eviction error identifiable and turns a survey-sampling variance estimator over the retained set into a per-step error certificate at one extra scalar per retained token. On a thirty-turn assistant compressed to a 10\% cache budget, the certificate-gated system answers 0.97 of recall questions against 0.09 for top-$k$, and for facts stated 26 to 30 turns earlier it recalls 97\% against 2\%. We prove that no estimator computable from the information a deterministic scheme retains is consistent for its own eviction error: evicted values can be altered so that everything retained is unchanged while the true attention-output

translated_title: 基于随机化设计的KV缓存逐出误差证书
translated_abstract: 确定性的KV缓存逐出策略根据重要性分数保留前k个token并删除其余部分，删除之后，服务系统无法知道这次逐出给当前查询造成了多大代价。我们用已知包含概率的泊松抽样取代确定性的尾部删除，这使得逐出误差变得可识别，并将保留集合上的抽样调查方差估计量转化为逐步的误差证书，每个保留token仅需一个额外的标量。在一个压缩至10%缓存预算的三十轮对话助手上，证书门控系统对回忆类问题的回答率达到0.97，而top-k仅为0.09；对于26至30轮之前陈述的事实，其回忆率为97%，而top-k仅为2%。我们证明，从确定性方案所保留的信息出发，任何估计量都无法对其自身的逐出误差保持一致：被逐出的值可以被改变，使得所有保留内容不变，而真实的注意力输出（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文用已知包含概率的泊松抽样替代确定性KV缓存逐出策略，使逐出误差可识别并生成逐步误差证书，在10%缓存预算下将长对话事实回忆率从2%提升至97%。
en_tdlr: Replacing deterministic KV-cache eviction with Poisson sampling at known inclusion probabilities makes eviction error identifiable through per-step error certificates, boosting long-conversation fact recall from 2% to 97% under a 10% cache budget.
